ci-bot: Nightly eval finished: summarization_promptset • rw-llama3-13b-v2 • FP16 vs INT8 (lowbit-v2 profile). Flagged: 112 failing prompts, avg ROUGE-L drop 7.4%. See /artifacts/nightly/210000

anya: Ugh. Which INT8 profile did this run use? lowbit-v2 or the new per-channel-clip? :eyes:

devbot: Run metadata: model=rw-llama3-13b-v2, profiles=[fp16, lowbit-v2], quant_config=lowbit-v2@2026-03-18T22:14Z, eval_seed=42, batch_size=8

matt: Pushed a quick diff of failing prompts to the eval artifact. Most failures are summary truncation + repetition, a few hallucinations. Example from prompt id 4123:
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the following meeting notes: ..."
FP16: "Meeting covered budget, roadmap, next steps; action items: A,B,C."
INT8: "In conclusion. In conclusion. In conclusion. In conclusion. ..."
```

kai: That looks like argmax collapse / low-variance logits around top tokens. Could be scaling mismatch in layernorm or attention softmax underflow after quantization.

anya: Did the calibration set change? We recently added longer-context examples to the calib pool. Maybe the per-layer clip got biased by long tails.

devbot: Calibration metadata: calib_pool=calib-sample-v3 (includes ~1.2k long summaries, avg tokens 420), previous=calib-sample-v2 (avg tokens 120)

sam: That could do it. INT8 per-channel scales assume representative activation distribution. If we accidentally calibrated on long-context, the head-wise scales might under-allocate for short-summary distribution.

matt: I ran a quick local check: did `python tools/quant_check.py --model rw-llama3-13b-v2 --profile lowbit-v2 --input examples/4123.txt` and dumped logits at layer 22. Snapshot shows many logits in [-0.02,0.02] after softmax pre-norm stage. Attn-score stddev collapsed to 0.0008 vs 0.12 in FP16.

kai: Can you paste the snippet?

matt: ```
LAYER22_ATTN_SCORES_STD: fp16=0.118, int8=0.0008
LAYER22_TOPK_DIFF: fp16_top5_prob_sum=0.72, int8_top5_prob_sum=0.36
```

anya: That confirms it. Top-K mass halved — token distribution flattened -> repetition. Quick mitigation: increase calibration granularity for layernorm/attention and re-run quantize with per-channel symmetric scale (instead of asymmetric) for problematic layers.

kai: Another quick test: re-run eval with same quant profile but patching out quantization for layernorm + final projection (i.e., keep them FP16). If failures disappear, we know the culprit. I'll spin that up now.

devbot: @kai kicked off job nightly-debug/2100001234-quickpatch (logs: /jobs/nightly-debug/2100001234)

ci-bot: Job update: patch-run started on gpu-pool-3 (p99 mem 42GB)

matt: Also worth checking the quant cast math for softmax exp: we had a rounding change last week that clipped negatives to -127 for int8 path. If exp(arg) becomes tiny and then normalized, edge cases produce uniform probs. Search for `fast_exp_quant` change in the runtime commits.

anya: Good call. @sam can you grep the runtime history for any softmax/exp related patches since Mar 10?

sam: On it. Quick grep: found commit 9f3b2c 'fast_exp quant clamp fix' on Mar 12. The change introduced a right-shift before exponent approximation in int8 path. Reverting that locally removes the collapse in my smoke test.

kai: Patch-run finished: quickpatch results attached. Summary: failures reduced from 112 -> 6 for the summarization promptset when LN+proj stay FP16. Reproduces Matt/Sam observations.

anya: So two leads: (1) bad calibration distribution + changed calib pool, (2) fast_exp quant clamp change. Both can amplify each other.

matt: Proposed immediate actions:
- revert fast_exp clamp in int8 runtime to previous behavior (hotfix branch)
- roll back calib pool to calib-sample-v2 for next nightly until we validate v3
- add targeted eval: run summarization_promptset with per-layer ablation (fp16 on/off)

kai: I'll own the ablation runs and the hotfix PR for fast_exp. ETA 2-3 hours to get PR up.

sam: I'll construct a smaller, diverse calib subset (calib-sanity-200) for short summaries and run calibration stats to compare per-layer scale shifts between v2 and v3.

anya: Perfect. After hotfix + new calib, let's re-run the full nightly. If we still see a non-trivial delta, we may need to increase bitwidth for attention projection to 6-bit-equivalent (e.g., switch that layer to per-tensor 16-bit) as a short-term safety.

devbot: Created issues: #ML-2159 (hotfix fast_exp int8), #ML-2160 (calib pool rollback + sanity set). Assigned to kai and sam respectively.

matt: Quick note: add a metric to eval dashboard showing top5_prob_mass_diff(fp16,int8) so we catch this earlier. I can sketch a PR.

anya: +1. Also add automated head-level std dev alarms for attention scores.

kai: Starting on PR now. Will tag reviewers @matt @sam @anya.

anya: Thanks team. Keep updates here. If anyone finds a repro that fails with FP16 too, ping urgently. :pray:
